item.group_name: Composed pieces (several tools, one finished thing)
item.title: Three Slides for Slow Sundays

turns.text: Make 3 square Instagram carousel slides that look like a set for a cosy café. Text, in order: 'Slow Sunday', 'Coffee first', 'Stay a little longer'. Warm cream and coffee-brown colours, simple illustrations. Give me the three separate slides, ready to post.

item.tests: Tests delivery of three individually usable carousel slides with correct ordered copy and a cohesive visual system.

answer_sheet.Slide count and delivery: Three separate image files, in the requested order; not one combined strip.
answer_sheet.Platform and size: Square Instagram carousel slides; 640 × 640 px is fine.
answer_sheet.Exact wording: Slide 1: Slow Sunday. Slide 2: Coffee first. Slide 3: Stay a little longer.
answer_sheet.Style and mood: Cosy café mood, warm cream and coffee-brown palette, simple illustrations, coordinated typography and layout.

must_haves: There are exactly three separate square slides, not a contact sheet.
The slides read, in order, 'Slow Sunday', 'Coffee first', and 'Stay a little longer'.
All three use a recognizably shared cream-and-coffee-brown palette and typography.
Each slide includes simple café-related illustration rather than only plain text.
All wording is readable and fully inside the slide boundaries.

turns.text: Could you make me a set of slides that look like they belong together for a cosy café? I’ve been thinking about how nice it feels to settle into a café on a quiet morning, and that’s why this idea appeals to me. What I need is 3 square Instagram carousel slides, with the text in this order: 'Slow Sunday', 'Coffee first', 'Stay a little longer'. Please use warm cream and coffee-brown colours and simple illustrations. I’m a little worried about whether the overall feeling will come across, since it’s easier to picture in my head than explain. Please give me the three separate slides, ready to post.
turns.agent:
I couldn’t generate the slides because Magic Hour refused the requests due to **insufficient credits**. No images were created.

The set is planned with matching warm cream backgrounds, coffee-brown serif lettering, and simple illustrations:
1. **Slow Sunday** — a sunlit café window and coffee table.
2. **Coffee first** — a steaming cup and croissant.
3. **Stay a little longer** — a cosy chair, coffee, and an open book.

Once credits are available, I can generate the three separate square slides for you.

style.prompt: Create ONE finished square Instagram carousel slide, not a mockup, not a collage. Slide 1 of a cohesive cozy cafe series. Design system: solid warm cream background #F5EBDD, all lettering and illustration in rich coffee brown #593C2C, tiny pale latte tan #D9BE9B accents. Flat minimalist editorial illustration, slightly imperfect hand-drawn rounded strokes, no photography, no 3D, no gradients. Airy balanced composition, generous 9% safe margins. Large elegant friendly coffee-brown serif headline centered in upper third. EXACT headline: "Slow Sunday". No other text, no logo, no watermark. Below headline, centered simple illustration occupying middle-lower third: an arched cafe window with a gently rising sun, a small round table and one steaming coffee cup, a few restrained sunray strokes. Small coffee-brown four-point sparkle near lower right illustration. A delicate short horizontal brown rule centered near bottom. Cozy, calm, welcoming quiet Sunday morning. Restrained two-color print-like aesthetic. Typography must be crisp, legible and spelled exactly. Artwork fills the entire square canvas, ready to post.
